				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>Does Instamojo support multi-currency payments?</h3></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_29 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">We do not support multi-currency payments on Instamojo. If an international card is being used for a transaction, your customer will be charged in Indian rupees (INR).</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_30 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>International payments are available at request. Availability of international payments are subject to KYC approval. Need more information? Feel free to write to <a href="mailto:support@instamojo.com" title="">support@instamojo.com</a>.</p></div>
			</div>

			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_32 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">Enterprise plan or custom pricing for online payments is available at request. You can simply get in touch with our team to figure out the right fee on your online payments. Please write to <a href="mailto:support@instamojo.com" title="">support@instamojo.com</a> to speak to an online payments expert at Instamojo.</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_33 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">If you’re looking for a <a href="/payment-gateway/" title=""> free payment gateway</a> option, feel free to try Instamojo convenience fee feature. It is well explained above.</div>
			</div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>When do I get my payouts?</h3></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_35 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">Instamojo settles all transactions on a transaction + 3 days basis. Payouts usually take 3 days because we settle money through our own nodal account to hundreds of merchants every day. If you’re interested in understanding how online payment gateways work, <a href="https://s3.amazonaws.com/uploads.instamojo.com/Ebooks/WhatisPaymentGateway.pdf" title=""> check out this simple guide </a>.</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_36 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">However, we also offer faster payout options like Instant Payout, Same Day payout, and Next Day payout. These options are available at a nominal extra fee. Faster payout options are subject to KYC approval.</div>
			</div>

			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_38 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">We charge 18% GST per transaction. Whenever you accept a payment, we calculate a fee on the transaction. Once the fee is calculated, we proceed to calculate any applicable taxes (GST) on the fees.</div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">Here is an elaboration of the GST calculation for your Instamojo transactions. Still unsure about GST calculation? Write to <a href="mailto:support@instamojo.com" title="">support@instamojo.com</a> for more information.</div>

				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_28 tablet_br_none  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>Does Instamojo support multi-currency payments?</h3></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_29 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">We do not support multi-currency payments on Instamojo. If an international card is being used for a transaction, your customer will be charged in Indian rupees (INR).</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_30 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>International payments are available at request. Availability of international payments are subject to KYC approval. Need more information? Feel free to write to <a href="mailto:support@instamojo.com" title="">support@instamojo.com</a>.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_24  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_31 tablet_br_none  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>Is there an enterprise plan for Instamojo payments? </h3></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_32 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">Enterprise plan or custom pricing for online payments is available at request. You can simply get in touch with our team to figure out the right fee on your online payments. Please write to <a href="mailto:support@instamojo.com" title="">support@instamojo.com</a> to speak to an online payments expert at Instamojo.</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_33 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">If you’re looking for a <a href="/payment-gateway/" title=""> free payment gateway</a> option, feel free to try Instamojo convenience fee feature. It is well explained above.</div>
			</div>
			</div>
				
				
				
				
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_19 et_pb_gutters4">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_25  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_34 tablet_br_none  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>When do I get my payouts?</h3></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_35 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">Instamojo settles all transactions on a transaction + 3 days basis. Payouts usually take 3 days because we settle money through our own nodal account to hundreds of merchants every day. If you’re interested in understanding how online payment gateways work, <a href="https://s3.amazonaws.com/uploads.instamojo.com/Ebooks/WhatisPaymentGateway.pdf" title=""> check out this simple guide </a>.</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_36 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">However, we also offer faster payout options like Instant Payout, Same Day payout, and Next Day payout. These options are available at a nominal extra fee. Faster payout options are subject to KYC approval.</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_26  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_37 tablet_br_none  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>How much GST does Instamojo charge?</h3></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_38 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">We charge 18% GST per transaction. Whenever you accept a payment, we calculate a fee on the transaction. Once the fee is calculated, we proceed to calculate any applicable taxes (GST) on the fees.</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_39 link_color  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">Here is an elaboration of the GST calculation for your Instamojo transactions. Still unsure about GST calculation? Write to <a href="mailto:support@instamojo.com" title="">support@instamojo.com</a> for more information.</div>
			</div>

                        function wpvl_paramReplace(name, string, value) {
                // Find the param with regex
                // Grab the first character in the returned string (should be ? or &)
                // Replace our href string with our new value, passing on the name and delimeter

                var re = new RegExp("[\?&]" + name + "=([^&#]*)");
                var matches = re.exec(string);
                var newString;

                if (matches === null) {
                    // if there are no params, append the parameter
                    newString = string + '?' + name + '=' + value;
                } else {
                    var delimeter = matches[0].charAt(0);
                    newString = string.replace(re, delimeter + name + "=" + value);
